title: Source-ID generalization & candidate surface validation
objective: Validate whether the frozen conservative source-ID semantic-extraction contract generalizes across diverse role JDs and candidate documents without tuning, while preserving deterministic provenance, full-surface ontology coverage, and high-risk semantic precision.
mustNotChange: deterministic Extraction V1 semantics or frozen-baseline behavior
production extraction authority remains the existing deterministic baseline
no Batch 05 architecture decision or recommendation
evaluation, policy, verdict, canonical persistence, dossier, serving, UI, or Batch 01 source/provenance immutability behavior
no benchmark-specific extractor fix, prompt/config tuning, fixture rewrite, or selective rerun after results without an explicit scope amendment
requiredVerification: freeze the validation population: 8 scored role JDs (4 diverse, 4 adversarial), 2 scored candidate documents, and 1 development control (FROZEN_ROLE_02)

inspect all 11 documents mechanically offline before provider execution; verify exact offset slices, bullet handling, glued headings, abbreviations, and freeze source-segmentation/v1 with zero semantic rules
author and lock reference truth (positive and negative boundaries) with reviewer provenance before any validation Gemini outputs are visible
implement experimental source-ID harness with wire schema adapter (const -> singleton enum), source-unit registry, and ID proposal parser/assembler
execute one locked Gemini provider execution per scored fixture (+ development control) using gemini-2.5-flash, ADC/Vertex, default thinking, temperature 0, topP 1

evaluate role and candidate quality separately, including source-reference validity, proposal semantic precision, material proposition selection recall, typed material recall, subject/evidence-class accuracy, case-level failure visibility, and full telemetry
acknowledge every governed implementation/test/substantive transition-documentation commit in docs/transition/IMPLEMENTATION_LEDGER.json
npm run transition:check after acknowledgement and before agent completion
completionEvidence: fixed 11-document population with immutable fixture identities and retained raw extraction artifacts
locked independent reference truth committed before provider execution
separate role and candidate metrics covering selection recall, typed recall, semantic precision, high-risk false positives, case-level failure visibility, latency, and cost
an evidence-only validation report with no extraction architecture selection, production authority change, canonical persistence, or downstream consumer change
extraction architecture decision remains OPEN and Batch 05 remains unauthorized
all governed commits made during the batch are acknowledged in the transition implementation ledger
agentCompletionRule: Every committed change touching a non-governance path must be acknowledged by exact commit SHA in docs/transition/IMPLEMENTATION_LEDGER.json before the agent may report completion. Uncommitted governed changes fail transition control. Tests are governed changes and require explicit authorization in allowedPathPrefixes. Update RADAR_TRANSITION_CONTROL.md itself only when gate/scope/decision/invariant/exit criteria change.
scopeChangeRule: If implementation requires a path, corpus change, score change, prompt/config/extractor change, or semantic owner outside this manifest, stop first. Amend the control record/state/batch scope explicitly; do not self-tune the benchmark. Batch 05 is not authorized by this manifest.
